title: Felix and the Wolf
author: B. M. Joubert
blurb: Marguerite Okafor, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
